rca of the issue: Pre-fix: aggregate Per-Component Breakdown path in engine_routes.py allocated RAW (no-markup) freight by board-consumed oMSF; the componentPricing path allocated MARKED-UP freight by finished finMSF/finShipWeight. With FOB=Ship + Per Job, these produced two different values per component (e.g. Header $19.32 vs $33.88 at qty 300). Fix: aggregate path now multiplies per-slot job freight by (1+markup) and allocates on finMSF/finShipWeight (storing pc.allocatedFreight). Verified live: across all 3 tiers, Header allocated freight in mp-pc-freight-2 == cost-buildup One-Time Freight markup-inclusive value == active-component card 'Freight:' value, and sum across all 3 components == Per-Job card amount for that tier.
